text:
Marina (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Glyder onboarding. Want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30-day timeline. @Sanjay @Emily can you confirm who owns SSO and data export on your side?
Sanjay (Glyder Product): Hi! I own product; Emily owns infra/SSO. High level: need staging inference by end of month, prod by 30 days.
Emily (Glyder Infra): Correct. We need clarity on network/vpc + KMS for keys. Also data residency — EU-only.
Tariq (Solutions): Noted EU residency. From Redwood side I'll own the integration guide and help size Dedicated if needed. What are your throughput targets?
Sanjay (Glyder Product): Initial traffic low, ~5 qps steady, bursts to 20 qps. p95 latency target <300ms.
Leah (Onboarding): I can run two 90-min enablement sessions for devs + infra. Available next Wed/Thu.
Marina (CSM): Proposed 30-day plan (high level):
````
Day 0: Kickoff (this thread)
Days 1-5: Access, SSO, API keys, infra checklist
Days 6-14: Dev integration -> staging, first end-to-end test
Days 15-21: Performance tuning, batching/quant profiles, cost targets
Days 22-28: Security review, compliance docs, runbook
Day 30: Prod cutover + handoff to success/ops
````
Marina (CSM): Success criteria (suggested):
- Staging end-to-end call working with real data
- p95 <300ms for target 5 qps workload
- Token cost estimate within agreed threshold
- SSO + KMS configured, audit logs flowing
- Dev team able to run retrain/rollout playbook
Sanjay (Glyder Product): Those criteria look good. One question: do you support model pinning during canaries? We want controlled rollouts.
Tariq (Solutions): Yes — canary rollouts and fallback policies supported. We'll include an initial rollout config in the repo.
Emily (Glyder Infra): For KMS we need a nod on HSM integration later — timeline okay?
Marina (CSM): HSM can be scoped post-prod cutover; we'll include it as a milestone for Month+2 unless compliance requires earlier.
Leah (Onboarding): I'll add enablement items: sample integration repo, quickstart, and an ops runbook template.
Sanjay (Glyder Product): Risk callout — renewal sensitivity: execs want measurable perf gains by 90 days. If cost or latency aren't met, renewal could be at risk.
Marina (CSM): Thanks for flagging. We'll track a small KPI dashboard: latency, errors, cost per 1k tokens and a weekly health email.
Tariq (Solutions): Next steps (assigned):
- Marina: schedule weekly 30-min standups (first one D+2)
- Leah: enablement slots + materials by D+4
- Tariq: integration guide + example repo by D+5
- Emily: confirm SSO/KMS requirements and EU region specifics by D+3
- Sanjay: provide sample payloads and acceptance tests by D+3
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Glyder Onboarding Standup — Wed 09:30 AM UTC. Invite sent to participants.
Marina (CSM): OK everyone — please drop any blockers here. If we agree, I'll turn this into a shared checklist and calendar invites. :thumbsup:
Sanjay (Glyder Product): 👍 we'll start prepping payloads.
Emily (Glyder Infra): I'll validate network constraints today.
Leah (Onboarding): I'll post the enablement calendar options by EOD.
Marina (CSM): Great — closing thread for now, will ping when checklist is up.
